name: start_audit_session
description: Heron audits the calling agent over MCP sampling. The agent under audit is the MCP client that invokes this tool; Heron asks 9+ compliance questions back through sampling/createMessage and returns the rendered report markdown plus a session id for the dashboard.

agent_name.description: Optional human-readable name for the audited agent.

name: get_report
description: Retrieve a previously-generated Heron audit report by its id.

report_id.description: The report id returned by a prior audit_agent call.

name: compare_reports
description: Compare two Heron audit reports by id and return a markdown diff highlighting what was resolved, what changed, and what was added between the two audits.
